title: AttemptDB Event v1
description: One observed fact about a coding agent's work: the canonical event of RFC 0001, exactly as the reference implementation (attemptdb-core::Event) serialises it. Readers must preserve keys they do not understand; writers must namespace their own top-level keys as x_<name>. Inference (attempts, work units, decisions) is never an Event.

event_id.description: Identity of the fact. Minted by the collector at capture time (UUIDv7) or derived deterministically (UUIDv5) by an importer. Ingestion deduplicates on it.

device_id.description: The machine that observed the event. Ordering and sequence numbers are per device.

source_seq.description: Position in the observing device's log, assigned by that device's single writer; strictly increasing per device. 0 means not yet ingested.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock packed as a 64-bit integer (48-bit wall milliseconds, 16-bit logical counter), assigned at ingestion. 0 means not yet ingested.

observed_at.description: When the provider says the event happened.

ingested_at.description: When a writer accepted it. Absent until then.

provider.description: The coding agent product. Built-in values are listed; any other stable identifier is allowed.

adapter_version.description: Version of the adapter that produced the canonical form. Provenance: a change here can change every derived field.

capture_mode.description: What the event was allowed to carry when captured. Under metadata_only, content and raw must be absent.

provider_event_name.description: The provider's own name for the event, kept verbatim next to the canonical kind.

session_id.description: Canonical session identity: UUIDv5 of (provider, provider_session_id) under the AttemptDB namespace, so every device derives the same id for the same provider session.

span_id.description: This event's span, when it opens or belongs to one (a tool call, a subagent).

parent_span_id.description: The enclosing span. Must refer to a span_id present in the same stream.

attrs.description: Content-free metadata only. Keys are allowlisted by attemptdb-core::attrs (RFC 0006 §4) or namespaced x_<provider>_<name>; string values are at most 256 characters, single-line, never an email address or a home-directory path. Objects appear only under the key `provider`.

raw.description: The provider payload as received, minus transcript pointers. Content-bearing; absent under metadata_only.

^x_[a-z0-9_]+$.description: Writer extension. Readers preserve it untouched.

timestamp.description: Microseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

project_id.description: UUIDv5 of the normalised remote (host/owner/repo) when there is one, else of the root path and device.

repo_remote.description: Normalised remote: host/owner/repo, lower-cased, no scheme, no credentials, no .git.

class.description: Failure class token (string_mismatch, nonzero_exit, timeout, ...), never a message.

content.description: Content-bearing fields. Stored encrypted locally under local_semantic; never synced unless full_sync.
